Two measurements, both MeasureHereAsync because navigating would destroy the alert state: the pass while work is waiting, and the board once a line is away and the undo exists. Reasoned height/font/reach check against app.css (not executed): every measured control resolves to ≥44px via --touch-target or .kitchen-line-button's min-height: 3rem, and every one inherits 1.05rem from .kitchen-board or declares 1.1rem, so the 16px floor clears. At 375px the panel's content box is 313px and the widest flex row (.kitchen-menu-item) sums to ~279px at its declared bases.
